response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a strong generalist background spanning web, mobile, and systems programming, but his resume shows almost no recent hands-on experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring, or JVM tooling — his core stack for the last decade has been TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and JavaScript ecosystems. There is no evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or enterprise Java framework work, which are central requirements for this role.
strengths: Long track record (15+ years) across diverse technical domains and languages
Demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex systems
Strong communication/teaching skills (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: No demonstrated recent professional experience with Java, Kotlin, or Spring
No evidence of IDE internals or developer tooling experience relevant to this specific role
Career trajectory is broad/generalist rather than deep JVM specialization

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling experience
Strong general software engineering craftsmanship and adaptability
